section_summary.extract_value: The present study used confirmatory factor analysis to evaluate the factor structure and cross-cultural equivalence of a Cantonese translation of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) in a large sample of adults in Hong Kong. It compared one- and two-dimensional models, examined construct validity via associations with BMI, actual-ideal weight discrepancy among women, and self-esteem, and tested sex differences (expecting higher scores in men).
section_summary.evidence_source: "we used confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) to evaluate the conceptual equivalence of the BAS in a large sample of adults in Hong Kong." "In summary, the present study examined the factor structure of a Chinese (Cantonese) translation of the BAS among adults in Hong Kong... In addition to an investigation of factorial validity, we conducted a preliminary examination of the construct validity of the newly translated scale by examining associations between derived body appreciation scores, body mass index (BMI), actual-ideal weight discrepancy among women, and self-esteem. Finally, we examined sex differences on body appreciation..."
